scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n pg,bff,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run pg:start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:server: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.build:client: npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:demo: npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build:demo --prefix client
